moduleSummaries.title: Getting Started
moduleSummaries.summary: How to get the most out of this guide. Nothing to pre-install — installing the Pentaho platform IS this course.

moduleSummaries.title: Overview
moduleSummaries.summary: What's new in Pentaho 11 — the modern UI, security improvements, and deployment changes that frame why the install procedure looks the way it does. Read this first. Plus the Support Portal downloads, licence activation and the component map — download the Pentaho Enterprise packages, activate your license key, and choose your installation path — Windows evaluation or Linux archive deployment.

moduleSummaries.title: Archive Installation
moduleSummaries.summary: Archive-based deployment on Linux end-to-end: prepare the environment, install the Pentaho Server on Tomcat 10 with PostgreSQL, add server and client-tool plugins, run post-install tasks, and apply upgrades and patches.

moduleSummaries.title: Install Client Tools
moduleSummaries.summary: Install the Pentaho design tools and their enterprise add-ons — the client plugins for the desktop tools and the EE Kettle (PDI) plugins — so practitioners can connect to and work against the server you deployed.
